Evergreen code AUG seen 3 times on CNYTN-USHOU (ONE HUMEN 101E etd 11 Sep, CONTI CORTESIA 014E etd 16 Sep, SEASPAN BENEFACTOR 077E etd 03 Oct). Not in the registry and not on the deny-list. n=3 so this is treated as a NEW SERVICE, not an extra loader - almost certainly Evergreen's Asia-US Gulf proforma, sister to AUE. Transits are irregular (29/32/40 days) against GME direct at 19-28 days, which is consistent with a transhipped Gulf routing. Promote to the registry after a second run confirms.
